takes.title: Walk Forward with Uneven Steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts mid-step and walks forward with alternating knee lifts and variable foot placement, ending mid-stride.

takes.title: Walk Forward from an Arms-Out Start
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with arms extended while stepping forward, lowers them, and continues with variable knee height. The take ends mid-stride.

takes.title: Walk with High Steps and Turns
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts stepping and continues through a long stretch of alternating high steps, intermittent forward leans, and turns. They face toward the original camera again near the end and finish mid-stride.

takes.title: Walk with High Steps and a Side-Facing Finish
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts mid-step, takes irregular alternating steps with periodic raised knees, and changes heading while leaning forward slightly. The take ends moving in side profile.
